notes.title: Welcome back to Erstwhile!
notes.content:
Welcome Back to the Erstwhile Annual LARP Event!

After nearly two years, and numerous requests for changes, the team decided to give Guardian a much needed rework. Since most of the original team had moved on, we dug into our player feedback and spent a lot of time and effort to try bringing you what you had requested.

After several months of rebalancing, repolishing, and reinvigorating Guardian to give you the best possible experience, Black Banshee Studios is proud to commence the Erstwhile Annual LARP Event, and we invite you to enjoy the new and (hopefully) improved Guardian.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616950/d72cbf3c2afbd3e8ae4d91315fee093b93cbc42f.png
Key Updates


 New Enemies
 New Bosses
 Additional Music Tracks
 New Artwork, Animations, and Effects
 A fully functioning shop
 X-Box and PlayStation Controller Support
 Expanded Upgrade System
 Improved Level Design
